verify.note: auto: at every hook call (h_new, h_tnew, h_clr, h_eo, h_teo, h_cls, h_msg) original and patched code from the same state to the same continuation, registers and 48K memory (dead stack aside), slot 4 restored; at every IM 1 the alt ROM image's handler against the original's (the image as the stub fills it over the system ROM3: set NEXCLASH_NEXT_ROM to enNextZX.rom, else rom3left cannot be seen); at every interrupt outside the plot code each object's sprite ink = the pixels its own XOR stores put on the original screen, palette = its colour; Enhanced tiles against their default tiles; default and Enhanced on every recording; 16 negatives on p1 (700 frames); the decrypter run to 0x8000 against s0 + the sites

techniques.target: alt ROM image 1 = Sinclair's 48K ROM + the hooks at 0x386E- (altrom 0x2000-0x4000 + altrom_low page 25): NextZXOS ROM3's IM 1 never reaches the hooks

one pool of all 128 4-bit patterns keyed by a 16-bit tile content id (build time): a tile any pattern holds is not uploaded; a pattern is reused only when none of the 128 object / truck entries names it (state page 26: OBJP, REFS, PCACHE, WHERE)

every hook reads R at a fixed M1 count from its site and sets it (rfix: bit 7 kept) at a fixed count before its return point, so R there is the original's; the verifier compares R (hooklib.CMP_R); the game takes its randomness from LD A,R (0x9466)

results.scope: 3 recordings, 22,090 frames IDENTICAL default and Enhanced, every IM 1 handler compared over NextZXOS ROM3; rom3left negative detected (pilot, 2026-11-04; re-run by selftest at the import)
